name: Assyria
overview: Scripture traces the origins of Assyria to the early post-Flood world, highlighting Nimrod as a mighty hunter before the LORD and the founder of kingdoms including Babel and cities within Assyria such as Nineveh. The land of Assyria is geographically situated east of the Tigris River, extending toward the region before Egypt. These details emphasize Assyria's antiquity and its foundational role in biblical history as a powerful empire established under divine sovereignty.
